title: The image in their mind
header_line: My analysis of one book on authority and personal brand. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What image do people have of you before they meet you?
A student summarized chapter 4: making a first impression before you have even met the person, because of social media. The chapter uses a famous chef as an example.

I said that I found the choice interesting, because that chef separated himself from other chefs by being an aggressive, unfiltered leader, when chefs before had acted aristocratic. I said it is a great example of branding.
A student said: your reputation is integral to being a leader, and the book compares different leaders, so you can stand out in your authority.
What do people picture when they hear your name?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what people see online before they meet you.
Write the first thing you will change.
Write who could tell you honestly.

check.q: What did a student say a first impression can happen through?
What did I say the chef did?
What did a student say is integral to being a leader?

recap: People form an image before they meet you. Choose it.
